widgets.text: Mission rewards buy new aircraft in the hangar; later fighters carry more missiles and turn faster, attackers are better against ground targets.
Fire missiles only after the lock tone; enemy fighters break off, so switch to the gun at close range. Ground targets: dive at a shallow angle and pull up early.
Missions are a campaign of air superiority, strike and escort sorties. The radar marks primary targets; destroying them all ends the mission.
Collect aircraft by clearing missions and earning money; the hangar shows every plane you own.
Clear missions in order; a mission's rank depends on time and targets destroyed.
